routes.rationale: Reach Kerning City's east exit without entering the dead-end 148-to-143 jump loop.
Reach Alex from Nella's platform without entering the 126-to-111 recovery loop.
Climb from the lowest Nautilus platform and reach the left exit through the rope route.
Reach the upper-left Pig and Ribbon Pig habitat without exploring dense irrelevant drop frontiers.
Reach the Forest South of Ellinia exit through the lower alternate ladder and the executable left ground route instead of unreliable 41-to-46, 13-to-50, and 13-to-11 transitions.
